title_short: Adopt-A-Block · Tiffany · Someone Is Here for You
headline: A single mother gives her Saturdays so other moms know someone is there for them. She found that love here, and she has more than enough to share.
story: Tiffany volunteers on the media team. Her two little daughters usually serve with her, one of them with a little camera. She is a single mother, so she knows the need is real. She shows her daughters that love is worth giving. Series: Faces of the Dream Center.

Loops: L1 “Who is she, and why does she say that?” opens 0:00 and closes at 0:14 (a volunteer, a single mother, her daughters serve with her). L2 “Where did she find it herself?” opens 0:00 and closes in the button. Stakes: a single mom with two little girls gives up her Saturday; the line is full of moms who think nobody is coming for them.
